entities.summary: Maximilian Heinrich Josef Heim is a German-Austrian Catholic priest and monk of the Cistercian Order. He has been the Abbot of the Heiligenkreuz Abbey since February 2011, and the Abbot President of the Austrian Cistercian Congregation from 2016 to 2025.
